entry_authority.reason: CT003 falsified full-hand Monte-Carlo targets for the existing scalar V critic, but did not test centralized Q values, policy expectation, Expected SARSA, or Q-boosted actor advantages. VR001 moves the intervention upstream to the estimator identified by the primary VRPO paper.

last_behavior_window.interpretation: MC scalar-V target failed all registered external score gates; critic/target family remains open only for materially different Q-boost design.

counterfactual_mechanism.risk: Sampled future-action noise in stochastic self-play can propagate through GAE even with an accurate V critic.
counterfactual_mechanism.test: Paired raw pre-normalization variance of VR001 Q-boost advantages versus the frozen legacy H11 GAE comparator on the same fresh actor rows.

falsifiable_hypothesis.prediction: On the exact H11/LG003C1 same start, replacing only the scalar-V GAE estimator and scalar-V critic training with a centralized legal-nine-action Q critic, policy-expectation values, and Expected-SARSA(lambda=.95) Q-boosting will reduce raw paired advantage variance and improve the 5M endpoint by at least 20 bb/100 versus both the frozen same-start control and historical H11 quick5k.
falsifiable_hypothesis.scientific_falsifier: A valid completed endpoint fails any registered external score or aggression gate.
falsifiable_hypothesis.mechanism_falsifier: The paired final-half raw advantage variance ratio is not below1, held-out Expected-SARSA target error does not improve, legal-action Q dispersion is degenerate, or any estimator/coverage/leakage invariant fails.

one_coherent_intervention.control: H11 scalar V critic plus sampled-action GAE(gamma=.999,lambda=.95)
one_coherent_intervention.treatment: Training-only centralized Q9 critic plus policy-expectation Vpi, Expected-SARSA(lambda=.95), Q-boosted actor advantages, and Q-lambda regression targets
actor_objective_unchanged: H11 decentralized actor input and exact 9-action abstraction
PPO ratio and Trinal-Clip policy objective
existing preflop and postflop action priors
actor Adam optimizer state and learning rate
environment_and_sampling_unchanged: fixed training deal stream and mirror-self-play rule
LG003 uniform five-member pool and assignment stream
worker count, rollout slots, actor sampling seed, and hand budget
removed_from_training: scalar V bootstrap in actor advantage
one_coherent_intervention.scalar_value_head_contract: The checkpoint-compatible scalar value head remains present but every value-head parameter is frozen, receives no gradient, and is excluded from all losses.

faithful_core: Vpi as legal-action policy expectation of Q
current-rollout-only critic data, which is paper-ablation comparable
registered_adaptations: CardPilot deals chance inside env.step, so each betting transition compresses sampled Nature transitions into its observed successor and retains chance variance.
gamma remains .999 rather than the paper recipe's 1.0.
H11 Adam, Trinal-Clip, entropy, and action priors remain frozen rather than adopting Muon, KL-to-uniform, or the paper schedules.
No EMA evaluation policy is introduced.
CardPilot keeps its fixed nine-slot betting abstraction and CNN actor instead of the paper's decomposed-action Transformer.
paper_fidelity_and_deviations.claim_limit: VR001 tests the causal Q-boost core under CardPilot's frozen actor objective; it must not be called an exact reproduction of the full paper recipe.

full_information_and_leakage_contract.actor_inputs_bit_contract: The existing card6x4x13, action25x4x5, extra2, and legal9 actor tensors remain byte-for-byte constructed by the parent path.

cards.construction: The active player's exact actor card6 tensor followed by one opponent-hole plane containing exactly the opponent's two already-dealt private cards.

action_history.construction: The exact actor action-history tensor for the active player before the physical action.

legal_mask.construction: Exact executable V5.5 action-slot mask before the physical action.

central_view.two_focal_views: Each physical betting action produces one target-player0 and one target-player1 central view. The shared Q critic predicts the selected focal player's return; actor advantage uses the view whose target is the active actor.

chronological_trace.row_order: Every physical betting action from both players in exact env.step order, including frozen-pool opponent actions.
chronological_trace.atomic_transport: One completed-hand pipe message carries legacy actor rows and the joint chronological trace; incomplete hands are discarded.
chronological_trace.chance_contract: Chance sampled inside env.step is compressed into the successor betting state. Undealt cards, future deck order, and RNG state are never stored in a central view.

information_barrier_tests: Changing opponent hole cards while holding actor infoset fixed may change Q but must leave actor logits bit-identical.
Changing assignment onehot while holding actor infoset fixed may change Q but must leave actor logits bit-identical.
Permuting the undealt future deck while holding current dealt state fixed must change neither actor logits nor Q.
Q tensors must never be passed into actor forward or official evaluation.
Actor and Q models must have disjoint Parameter objects, storages, optimizers, gradients, and state_dict namespaces.

qboost_math_contract.illegal_actions: Excluded exactly from pi expectation; probabilities are normalized over the legal mask and illegal Q outputs are not overwritten.
qboost_math_contract.actor_row_selection: Only rows controlled by the trainable hero model update the actor; all physical rows remain in the residual trace and critic regression.

actor_phase.q_snapshot: Freeze Qbar once at actor-phase start and do not mutate Q until all actor epochs finish.
actor_phase.recompute: At the start of every actor epoch, recompute hero/self-play probabilities, Vpi, the complete-hand reverse traces, and Aboost on the entire fresh rollout before minibatch shuffling.
actor_phase.pool_policy: For a frozen-pool-controlled row, use the exact serving pi_ref9 captured during rollout; never substitute the current hero policy.
actor_phase.detach: Detach Aboost only after whole-trajectory recomputation.
actor_phase.normalization: Normalize the complete set of trainable fresh-rollout Aboost values globally once per actor epoch before creating minibatches; never normalize per minibatch.
actor_phase.loss: Existing H11 Trinal-Clip PPO policy loss, entropy, and registered action priors only.

critic_phase.target_timing: After actor phase, freeze the post-actor hero policy and use it with the unchanged pre-critic Qbar snapshot to compute one fixed Qtarget tensor for the current rollout.
critic_phase.pool_policy: Frozen-pool rows continue to use captured exact pi_ref9.
critic_phase.target_reuse: The fixed semi-gradient target is reused for all four critic epochs.

reference_contract_tests: Scalar hand traces with analytically computed Vpi, residuals, advantages, and Q targets.
full-hand recomputation invariant to minibatch permutation.

architecture: Independent CNNBranch(in_channels=25,norm_layer=bn) for active-perspective action history.
Concatenate both flattened CNN outputs and conditioning32.
q_critic_and_optimizer.rng_isolation: Construct and initialize Q under torch.random.fork_rng and use a dedicated critic minibatch generator; actor sampling, deal RNG, and global actor initialization state must remain unchanged.
q_critic_and_optimizer.hidden_initialization: Inherited PyTorch default initialization under the dedicated Q seed.
q_critic_and_optimizer.output_initialization: All Q output-head weights and biases exactly zero.
q_critic_and_optimizer.zero_init_reason: The first actor update starts from a legal trace return rather than arbitrary random action-value dispersion; this is frozen initialization, not a warmup window.

mechanism_success: For every update record paired raw pre-normalization Var(Aboost) and Var(legacy H11 GAE) on the exact same fresh trainable actor rows.
Median Var(Aboost)/Var(legacy GAE) over the final half of updates must be strictly below1.
On a deterministic frozen held-out trace split, median Expected-SARSA Q-target absolute error in the final quartile must be strictly below the first quartile.
Median legal-action Q standard deviation over the final half must be strictly above0.
Record raw advantage means, standard deviations, variance ratio, Q gradient norms, Q parameter delta, and Q-target correlation without using them as post-hoc gates.
mechanism_and_endpoint_gates.throughput: Record effective hands per second and peak CPU/GPU/RAM, but throughput is not a scientific success gate unless the registered runtime abort prevents a valid endpoint.

checks: JSON parses and identity basis hashes exactly.
AGENTS authority and every frozen input hash match.
Every planned implementation output path is absent.
Math equations, terminal conventions, actor-phase recomputation, and fixed critic-target timing are complete.
Joint chronological trace, two focal views, exact pool pi, and assignment conditioning are unambiguous.
Privileged features cannot reach actor and future deck cannot reach critic.
Actor/Q storage, optimizer, gradient, RNG, and checkpoint namespaces are independent.
5M budget, abort, mechanism, quick5k bundle, and four external gates are exact.
Formal claim bar and all remaining non-V6 families remain unchanged.

abort_and_rollback.rollback: Exact frozen H11 source remains canonical and VR001 is never resumed after terminal judgment.
